system_thesis_interpretation: The paper thesis remains a Dream-LoRA-Think study of when a fixed agent should compile later-outcome-grounded lifetime experience into connected memory and when identical content should be transported into weights, with explicit graph retrieval as a primary baseline and LoRA credited only for access or transport. V3 wisely does not pretend to test that thesis. It is a closed finite prerequisite that asks whether one proposed causal family has the intended posterior and symbolic action geometry before rendering, learning, or model evaluation. Its scientific contribution, if implemented exactly and all ten checks pass, is limited to validating a small benchmark-design kernel. It supplies no evidence of development, learned representation, schema generalization, compression, model usability, parametric transport, organ mediation, on-policy learning, efficiency, or superiority, and it cannot decide the paper's weights-versus-memory question. A later common-deck rendered study must still preserve native-context pressure, prospective action use, old retention, increasing causal depth or interacting structure, strong graph/RAG/A-MEM/Bayesian/TMEM-like baselines, identical-corpus comparisons, resource curves, outer-unit inference, and honest negative outcomes.
graph_delta_interpretation: The v2 seven-node rendered execution graph is fully removed and replaced by a five-node local acyclic symbolic graph: a hash-and-scope authority gate, the exact alignment enumerator, four isolated posterior projections represented as one graph node but four visibility principals, a twin/cost/bridge checker, and a terminal report validator. Authority sends constants only. The enumerator sends canonical domain tuples to projections/checker but only aggregate counts to the report; projections and checker send only registered aggregates and closed pass summaries to the report. There is no feedback or report-to-input edge. The finite domain is mathematically coherent: pi maps descriptors bijectively to roles within raw, intermediate, and top types in literal 4! by 2! by 2! nested order, hence 96 alignments. GRAPH is obtained by inverting pi to render the four registered role recipes in descriptor symbols, ordering outputs DI0,DI1,DT0,DT1 and ingredients by the global descriptor order; CAL is the two intermediate edges and TOP is the chosen top edge's ingredient pair. A fixed CAL reveals a descriptor partition but not its latent I0/I1 orientation; the residual multiplicity is two intermediate orientations times two raw swaps within each pair times two top-role assignments, or 16. For each goal, those residual bits yield four distinct TOP pairs with multiplicity four. Tau exchanges the two raw ingredient groups while fixing intermediate/top roles, so it is an involution, changes both intermediate and both top triples, changes TOP for either goal, and preserves the purely structural costs. This graph closes the seed and ambient-controller pathways, but the combined SKN03 graph label must not weaken the four separate runtime capabilities mandated by the visibility matrix.
loop_delta_interpretation: The only proposed active loop is a single terminating local CPU derivation after, and only after, an exact releasable consensus and human ratification. It verifies bindings/scope, derives the 96 records, evaluates LOCAL, MOTIF_SCHEMA, RANDOM_SOURCE, and ORACLE only through their positive projections, checks twins and the action algebra, then validates ordered SK01-SK10 receipts and returns one canonical report. Missing authority, stale bytes, exceptions, nondeterminism, resource exhaustion, malformed or missing receipts, or test-infrastructure failure precede scientific evaluation and yield REWORK; a mechanically complete falsification yields REJECT; only ten passes yield RETAIN_SYMBOLIC_KERNEL. Every outcome is terminal and grants no renderer, model, GPU, promotion, fallback, or claim authority. Scientifically, the regime probability spaces are now literal rather than empirical: MOTIF samples one uniform pi and reuses it; RANDOM samples pi_s0, pi_s1, and pi_t independently and uniformly from the 96-set. Conditioning on CAL(pi_t) and g leaves the 16-member target class. Because the two source graphs are functions only of independent source factors, their joint counts factor from target TOP counts exactly, so RANDOM_SOURCE has the same four-by-four support and 1/4 optimum as LOCAL and conditional mutual information is exactly zero by integer identities. In MOTIF the complete source GRAPH contains the persistent target top edge, hence TOP is a point mass. This is deliberately information geometry, not a learned loop or evidence-producing life.
claim_delta_interpretation: The claim firewall is appropriately severe. C01 is narrowed to exact agreement between an exhaustive implementation and the registered symbolic invariants and permits only a fresh proposal for a rendered common-deck instrument. C02-C07 are retired. C08 explicitly limits tau to authentic semantic-content dependence, CONJ to conjunctive retention, and BRIDGE to a registered symbolic old-to-new dependency. Within this narrow estimand the v2 seed-fingerprint confound is genuinely eliminated by construction, not merely tested away: there is no q, seed, PRNG, handle, nuisance byte, rejection event, renderer, or finite realized-seed population, and the RANDOM legal joint view is a Cartesian product whose source factors contain no target factor. The former ATOM-baseline recomputation confound is also absent within v3 because no ATOM or source-atoms baseline exists: LOCAL receives only target c,g, while RANDOM_SOURCE and MOTIF_SCHEMA receive explicitly named complete graphs in isolated functions. This is elimination by removing the disputed baseline and relabeling LOCAL honestly, not proof that a fair atoms-only baseline has been solved for the future rendered benchmark. Moreover MOTIF_SCHEMA's value 1 comes from access to the complete persistent source graph, including the relevant top edge; it must not be described as learned schema induction or prospective generalization. The one-versus-two source-graph arity difference is ancillary under the exact product measure and both projections know their declared regime, but it still cannot stand in for the later required common-deck model comparison.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The matrix is structurally complete at 115 information items by 8 stage principals, or 920 unique cells. Its strongest repair is positive field-level projection: each of LOCAL(c,g), MOTIF_SCHEMA(graph,c,g), RANDOM_SOURCE(graph0,graph1,c,g), and ORACLE(pi_t,g) sees the immutable public contract/domain table plus only its named runtime inputs, derives its own exact value/chosen pair/support table, and cannot see another projection's inputs or outputs. The full enumerated domain is a fixed public inference table, not sampled target truth; target identity reaches only ORACLE. LOCAL therefore cannot recompute source alignment because it has no source observation at all, and RANDOM_SOURCE cannot infer pi_t from source graphs because the literal measure makes them independent. The checker retains per-case twins, costs, and interventions internally and exports only failure counts and histograms. The report sees bindings, exact scope/constants, registered aggregates, audit inventory, and closed boolean/observed summaries, while hidden alignments, per-input answer tables, plans, tracebacks, paths, timestamps, host data, and free-form debug are forbidden. This is a credible noninterference contract, contingent on SK08/SK10 enforcing separate invocation contexts with no ambient globals, caches, shared mutable objects, exception payloads, or debug paths. The visibility product itself does not define the still-missing value-level report schema or the legal malformed-input behavior of each projection.
acceptance_test_interpretation: SK01 is a decisive exact-domain check: the literal nested permutations must yield 96 distinct pi records and every GRAPH exactly four ordered triples. SK02 must partition the same 96 records by exact CAL tuples; the analytic expectation is six calibration values, each of size 16, although only the class-size invariant is normatively required. SK03 is the decisive seed-confound repair: for every c,g it must show four TOP pairs at count four and 1/4, and over all 96^3 RANDOM triples prove source/target count factorization with integers rather than floating-point mutual information. SK04 checks all 96 by two persistent cases and must obtain a point mass from GRAPH(pi),CAL(pi),g; this certifies direct persistent-source information, not learned schema. SK05's tau facts follow from the role permutation and must be checked over all alignments and both goals; equal 5/8 costs are difficulty matching only and twins identify authentic-content dependence only. SK06's algebra is raw=2, intermediate=2+2+1=5, top=5+2+1=8, CONJ=8+8=16, and BRIDGE=8+8+1=17; these are definitions over independent component productions, not environment shortest paths. SK07 improves on v2 by making both old and new top products inputs to the final B edge, so deletion of a typed required input destroys the join; however its universal substitution and within-budget language is not uniquely testable until old/new namespaces, legal substitute plans, inventories, and the plan-validity predicate are bound. SK08 should exhaust every legal input to four separately isolated pure projections, check exact reduced values 1/4,1,1/4,1, result fields, complete sorted supports, and literal descriptor-index tie-breaking; it also needs a closed legal-input/malformed-input registry to make 'every legal input' exact. SK09 is scientifically important because terminality alone does not prevent declassification, but the current contract lists 16 keys without fully binding protocol_id, value types/ranges, histogram aggregation units and key encodings, each receipt's observed schema, or a complete invalid-fixture registry, so one canonical golden receipt is not yet derivable. SK10 correctly requires strict absence, including dormant capability, and exact equality to three requested and eight forbidden scope atoms; its independently signed exact-tree evidence additionally needs a bound tree-manifest/signature format and reviewer identity rule. SK01-SK06 establish the central finite mathematics; SK07-SK10 still contain specification-level exactness gaps that post-choice tests cannot retroactively cure.
assumptions: GRAPH(pi) is read as rendering role recipes through the inverse of the declared descriptor-to-role bijection pi; otherwise the phrase rendered in descriptor symbols is not executable.

The RANDOM measure is exactly uniform on the full ordered Cartesian product of two source alignments and one target alignment, while MOTIF is exactly uniform on one alignment reused by source and target; no unlisted selection or nuisance variable exists.

A legal MOTIF_SCHEMA input requires graph=GRAPH(pi), c=CAL(pi) for the same pi, and a registered goal; a legal RANDOM_SOURCE input requires two canonical source graphs, c from an independently varying target alignment, and a registered goal.
The exact posterior projections may enumerate the public 96-domain but receive no sampled target index or target pi except in ORACLE.
CONJ and BRIDGE costs assume two separately produced, non-shareable top products with no reusable inventory or overlapping raw-action credit.
RETAIN_SYMBOLIC_KERNEL is interpreted only as an implementation-conformance result for this symbolic contract and never as a benchmark, model, developmental, compression, composition, or paper claim.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: I disagree that the current bound bytes already define an exact closed report schema or make SK09 uniquely executable.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: They bind the 16 top-level names, reduced-fraction and histogram container shapes, receipt field names/order, forbidden categories, JCS, and trailing LF, but omit the exact value schema and aggregation units. In particular, random_support_count_histogram can honestly summarize support cardinality per case or individual support-cell counts; cost histogram populations can count roles, alignments, or alignment-goal cases; and observed is only called a closed summary without per-test grammar. Post-implementation goldens would certify choices made after ratification.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Before implementation ratification, add a strict machine-readable report schema plus exact per-field derivations, histogram populations/order/key encodings, per-test observed schemas, protocol_id/verdict enums, invalid fixtures, and pre-choice canonical golden bytes/hash; bind the resulting bytes in a revised change.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: I disagree that SK07 as written exhaustively proves substitution necessity for every alignment pair, even though B <- old_g + new_g is a genuine symbolic two-input dependency.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Deletion necessity follows from treating the two products as typed required inputs. Substitution necessity does not follow until old/new namespaces, output identity, substitute set, inventories, plan equivalence, and budget-feasibility semantics are formal. If substitutions may produce the same required product they need not fail; if every substitute is defined as wrong, the test is tautological. The current cost grammar fixes only scalar costs and does not close this intervention space.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Bind a typed old/new product namespace, immutable plan AST, production/inventory semantics, explicit intervention set excluding identity-equivalent plans, and an exact BRIDGE validity/feasibility predicate; then enumerate the registered cases and report the expected count.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: I disagree with any reading that v3 validates an atoms-only baseline or proves the future rendered benchmark free of the v2 atoms-baseline confound.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: V3 correctly removes ATOM and gives LOCAL only c,g, so no source-atoms recomputation leak exists inside this kernel. That is a scoped deletion, not a construction of a fair baseline that receives the same source atomic evidence while lacking only reusable alignment. MOTIF_SCHEMA also receives the complete source graph and can directly read the persistent top edge. The proposal itself mostly respects this distinction, but the scientific interpretation must make it explicit.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Retain LOCAL's honest target-local label and forbid atoms-baseline or learned-schema claims from v3. Require the later rendered common-deck proposal to bind a positive, recomputation-closed atoms projection and compare it under equal source observations if such a baseline is scientifically needed.
